statement: A Fusion, Synchro, Xyz or Link Monster must first be Summoned properly, by its own kind of Summon or one treated as it, before it can be Special Summoned from the GY or from being banished.

sources.says: A monster that must be Special Summoned a specific way can be Special Summoned from the GY or banishment by an effect only if it was first Summoned properly.

scripts: The scripts say it for each card (EnableReviveLimit).
